title: BrokerServices
description: Schema root: every broker wire type under one document so the shared `$defs` (`ServiceErrorCode`, `CorrelationId`, `EmitBatchEntryStatus`, …) are emitted once and the generated clients reference one definition set.

CapabilityBinding.description: Exact descriptor identity admitted for one workload.

descriptor_digest.description: Digest of the complete descriptor approved by admission.

CapabilityId.description: A versioned service verb that can be admitted independently.

CapabilityInvocation.description: Typed invocation metadata carried alongside the existing broker payload.

binding.description: Exact binding the caller claims to use.

invocation_id.description: Bounded request identity used for replay refusal and audit joins.

CostReport.description: Response for both `host.cost.v1` verbs: the accumulated spend for the queried scope.

spent_micros_usd.description: Accumulated spend for the queried scope, in micro-USD (1e-6 USD).

EmitBatchEntryStatus.description: Per-entry status in a batch response.

oneOf.description: This entry was appended; carries the chain head as of the append.
This entry was rejected — the batch may have stopped at this entry depending on `stop_on_error`.
Batch stopped before this entry was processed (because an earlier entry failed). No append was attempted.

entries.description: Entries to append, in order. Length capped at [`BROKER_AUDIT_BATCH_MAX`]; total bytes capped at [`BROKER_AUDIT_BATCH_BYTES`].

chain_head.description: Final chain head after the last successful append. Equal to the pre-batch chain head if every entry was rejected.

statuses.description: Per-entry status, one per input entry, in input order.

EmitErrorCode.description: Per-entry error code for batch responses.

oneOf.description: Entry serialises to more than [`BROKER_AUDIT_RECORD_BYTES`] bytes.
Entry parse failed (unknown fields, bad timestamp, etc.).
Audit-signer rejected the entry (chain drift, fsync failure, internal error). Inspect `message` for the underlying code.

fields.description: Typed workload-supplied fields. The broker treats them as opaque JSON; they're carried verbatim into the chain entry's `fields` after the per-record byte-cap check.

ts.description: Wall-clock timestamp in RFC 3339 form. The broker handler records its own timestamp in addition for clock-jump detection.

chain_head.description: SHA-256-or-equivalent hash of the JCS-canonical chain entry bytes, signed by `mvm-audit-signer`'s chain key. This is the new chain head after the append.

ServiceCall.description:
The host-bound envelope every broker call rides on.

The envelope itself is strictly typed (`deny_unknown_fields`); the `payload` is `serde_json::Value` because per-handler payloads vary. The handler's `parse_payload` step is the *real* schema gate for payload contents.

capability.description: Optional typed capability metadata. Omitted for the established service-call path so its serialized shape remains byte-compatible.

ServiceErrorCode.description: Typed broker error codes. Audit log entries carry the code as a stable snake_case string. New variants are additive; renames are wire-breaking.

oneOf.description: The workload's `ExecutionPlan.services` did not bind this service.
The service exists in the static catalog but the verb is not implemented yet.
The handler's typed `parse_payload` rejected the payload shape.
Token-bucket rate limit exceeded (gate 4).
Lifetime quota for this `(workload, service)` exhausted.
Bounded vsock receive queue at capacity.
Handler response exceeded `response_size_cap()`.
Handler call timed out per `call_timeout()`.
Handler-internal failure: dispatch panic, circuit-breaker open, downstream (e.g. mvmd) unavailable.
Subprocess hasn't finished initial config + listener bring-up yet (bootstrap-order failure mode).
Service composition exceeded the depth cap.
Service composition exceeded the width cap.
Per-workload total-call/minute budget exceeded; escalates to audit + (optional) workload pause.
Operator revoked this workload's broker session.
Catch-all for unexpected handler-internal errors. Never carries payload-derived information in the message.
Typed capability admission refused the request.
Typed capability binding identity or descriptor digest did not match.
Typed capability protocol version is unsupported.
Typed capability invocation id was already consumed.
Typed capability input exceeded its admitted bound.
Typed capability output exceeded its admitted bound.
Typed capability invocation was canceled.
Typed capability handler failed without exposing handler details.

ServiceId.description:
Reverse-DNS-like service identifier with a mandatory version segment.

Examples: `host.secrets.v1`, `host.time.v1`, `host.cost.v1`, `broker.v1`.

Strings are validated at construction so the gate code can rely on the shape (in particular, the version segment is the rate-limiting parser for the binding gate).

ServiceResponse.description: The guest-bound envelope. Tagged variant; `Ok` carries the typed response payload, `Err` carries a typed error code + message.

TimeNowResponse.description: Response for `host.time.v1::now`: the host wall-clock, milliseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

wall_ms.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch, host-authoritative.
